units.source_text: "所谓优雅的坟墓，竟是这样寒碜啊！"

en.t: So this is what they call an elegant grave, and how shabby it is!

units.source_text: "拥有政治权力和财力的人留下了漂亮的墓，留下了富丽堂皇的墓。

en.t: People who had political power and wealth left behind beautiful graves, magnificent graves.

units.source_text: 这帮人生前简直没有一点想像力，

en.t: Those people had not the slightest imagination while they were alive,

units.source_text: 他们的墓自然也是没有一点想像力的启才来建造的。

en.t: so naturally their graves too were built by talents with not the slightest imagination.

units.source_text: 而优雅的人则只依靠自己和他人的想像力而生活，

en.t: But elegant people live only by relying on their own imagination and that of others,

units.source_text: 他们的墓也只能是运用想像力而留下来的。

en.t: and their graves can only be left behind through the use of imagination.

units.source_text: 我觉得这种墓很是凄凉。

en.t: I find graves like that terribly desolate.

units.source_text: 因为死后仍然要继续乞讨他人的想像力啊。"

en.t: Because even after death, they still have to go on begging for other people’s imagination.
